scope: Shared common-tube predicate and record replay for the one already-selected archived R3 proof. Does not rerun or alter the R3 native evaluator.
memory_cap: not separately enforced; exact-rational bit/operation/wall caps apply
retry_policy: No cap change or retry under this profile. Any further code/profile change requires a new version.
version_reason: Same numeric limits as v1; new version because v1 exposed an implementation bug where an adapted TubeSegment and common checker used different Budget objects.
selection_binding: reuse the first frozen R3 record ID and its exact semantic/line hashes; no outcome-based reselection
